entities.summary: Maxim Alexandrovich Lazarev is a Russian entomologist specializing in the study of Coleoptera. He is active in education and scientific research, and holds the degree of Candidate of Pedagogical Sciences (2013). He has been a Professor at the Russian Academy of Natural History since 2021. Lazarev is a member of the Entomological Section of the Moscow Society of Naturalists and has served as editor-in-chief of the journal Humanity space: International almanac since 2012.
